notes.title: release 2.12.5.1 multiplayer issues
notes.notes:
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
* Binoculars cannot Lock onto while invisible state. The Person cannot see you.	

* Add static Aircraft Carriers to the Tactics Map for HarborDefense

* Key I to toggle the instructions in context for their station.	

* Remove the Crew Models and Have only Captain, Crew and Pilot

* Different Language dialog should only be for Crews. Why does a Captain care?	

* Add flight deck to Carrier Beta model

* Add Aircraft Carrier contact symbols to Tactics Map.		
[/list]

[b]Fixed:[/b]
[list]
* Escort crossing harbor boundary did NOT trigger a victory condition.	

* Liberty ship helm camera does NOT show new water

* Easter Island Heads are missing from harbors on Escort map	

* Crew waiting in lobby did NOT get Victory condition dialog. Harbor Defense. Crew in game got it.	

* Get rid of the air raid siren when joing ship/lobby			

* No water splash where torpedo hits the ship. Use to do it?	

* Projectile splashes in water no longer visible.		

* Unable to see where projectiles hit water. Cannot figure out where landing.	

* Check if fireball explosion is removed after effect is complete
[/list]
